GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (max) currently leads AA-Image-T2I v2.0 with an Elo score of 1197.

The top models on AA-Image-T2I v2.0 by Elo rating are: 1. GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (max) (Elo 1197), 2. GPT Image 2.5 Flare (max) (Elo 1191), 3. GPT Image 2 (high) (Elo 1172), 4. Grok Imagine Image 2.0 (Elo 1155), and 5. MAI-Image-2.6 (Elo 1151). Rankings are based on blind votes from our recruited human panel, together with public Image Arena votes cast before 1 January 2026.

Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from blind comparisons judged by our recruited human panel, together with public Image Arena votes cast before 1 January 2026. Voters compare two images generated from the same prompt without knowing which model created each image. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often.
